plan: docs/v2/STAGE-C-PLAN.md v1.1 (Board APPROVE WITH CHANGES, all applied)
principle: Describes conditions, not the next move. Supportive / headwind is a stated financial convention, never fitted to outcomes and never tested as a forecast. No row has a tested link to later price (2019-26).

flatBands.why: 0.25 x the median absolute value of each series over 2019-01..2026-10 (indicator only)

leverage.oiRule: OI change over 7 days > 0 (all 6 perps, BTC)

value.label: Valuation
value.reading: Median of 3 percentiles vs own history (expanding, point-in-time): MVRV (CoinMetrics, series from 2010, percentile from 2018); price vs 200-week average (Coinbase, from 2019-05); nearness to the all-time high (Coinbase, from 2015). High percentile = expensive for all three.

cheap.label: Cheap
cheap.meaning: BTC trades low against its own history on all three measures: holders on average sit near their cost and price is far below its highs.

belowAvg.label: Below average
belowAvg.meaning: Valuation is below its historical middle: holders' average profit is modest.

fair.label: Fair
fair.meaning: Valuation sits around the middle of its history.

rich.label: Rich
rich.meaning: Valuation is above its historical middle: holders on average sit on clear unrealised gains.

stretched.label: Stretched
stretched.meaning: Valuation is in the top fifth of its history: price is far above holders' average cost and near its highs.

trend200.label: Long-term trend
trend200.reading: Close vs the 200-day average and the 200-day average's slope over 20 days (engine T3 parts).

up.label: Uptrend
up.meaning: Price is above a rising 200-day average: the long-term trend is up.

down.label: Downtrend
down.meaning: Price is below a falling 200-day average: the long-term trend is down.

transition.label: Transition
transition.meaning: Price and the 200-day slope disagree: the long-term trend is changing or flat.

structure.label: Medium-term structure
structure.reading: Close > 20-day > 50-day average with the 20-day rising over 5 days (FW1 base rule), plus the 30-day value-area state (engine E2).

up.label: Uptrend
up.meaning: Price sits above rising short and medium averages.

down.label: Downtrend
down.meaning: Price sits below falling short and medium averages.

mixed.label: Mixed
mixed.meaning: Short and medium averages do not line up: no clear medium-term direction.

auction.TESTING_VAH: testing the top of the 30-day value area
auction.TESTING_VAL: testing the bottom of the 30-day value area
auction.FAILED_AUCTION_HIGH: failed auction above value (rejected back inside)
auction.FAILED_AUCTION_LOW: failed auction below value (rejected back inside)

leverage.label: Leverage
leverage.reading: Binance perp premium (8 h), percentile vs history (engine E3a) — a basis measure — with open interest change over 7 days and funding shown alongside.

crowdedLong.label: Crowded long
crowdedLong.meaning: Perp buyers pay a high premium while open interest is rising: leveraged longs are building, which is liquidation fuel on a drop.

highPremium.label: High premium
highPremium.meaning: Perp buyers pay a high premium; open interest is not rising or its 7-day change is unavailable, so crowding is not confirmed.

shortCrowded.label: Short-crowded
shortCrowded.meaning: Perps trade at a low premium while open interest rises: shorts are building, which is squeeze fuel on a rise.

lowPremium.label: Low premium
lowPremium.meaning: Perps trade at a low premium without rising open interest.

normal.label: Normal
normal.meaning: The perp premium is within its usual range.

spot.label: US spot demand
spot.reading: Coinbase premium vs Binance, z-score against its last 30 days (engine E5a).

payingUp.label: Paying up
payingUp.meaning: US spot buyers pay more than usual versus their recent norm.

normal.label: Normal
normal.meaning: The US spot premium is within its recent norm.

discount.label: Discount
discount.meaning: US spot trades at a discount versus its recent norm: US buyers are less eager than usual.

liquidity.label: Stablecoin liquidity
liquidity.reading: USDT + USDC supply growth over 30 days minus its own 365-day median growth (engine T4 raw).

growing.label: Growing faster than usual
growing.meaning: Stablecoin supply grows faster than its usual pace: more dollar liquidity is entering crypto.

flat.label: Usual pace
flat.meaning: Stablecoin supply grows at about its usual pace.

shrinking.label: Slower than usual
shrinking.meaning: Stablecoin supply grows slower than its usual pace, or shrinks: less new dollar liquidity.

holders.label: Long-term holders
holders.reading: Long-term-holder supply, net change over 30 days (bitcoinmagazinepro; about a quarter of dates are ambiguous and the series can be revised).
holders.note: Not coloured: long-term holders distribute into every bull market, so selling is not on its own a negative.

adding.label: Adding
adding.meaning: Long-term holders' supply grew over 30 days: coins are ageing into strong hands.

flat.label: Flat
flat.meaning: Long-term holders' supply barely changed over 30 days.

distributing.label: Distributing
distributing.meaning: Long-term holders' supply fell over 30 days: older coins are being sold or moved.

sentiment.label: Sentiment
sentiment.reading: Crypto Fear & Greed index (alternative.me). It already includes momentum and volatility, so part of it repeats the trend and volatility rows.

extremeFear.label: Extreme fear
extremeFear.meaning: The crowd is very fearful (contrarian convention: fear is where sellers are exhausted).

neutral.label: Neutral
neutral.meaning: The crowd is neither fearful nor greedy.

extremeGreed.label: Extreme greed
extremeGreed.meaning: The crowd is very greedy (contrarian convention: greed is where buyers are exhausted).

volatility.label: Volatility
volatility.reading: 30-day realized volatility percentile vs history (engine E6) and ATR as % of price.
volatility.note: Not coloured: this is the size of the swings, not their direction.

calm.label: Calm
calm.meaning: Swings are small against BTC's history; calm phases end, often abruptly.

normal.label: Normal
normal.meaning: Swings are in their usual range.

elevated.label: Elevated
elevated.meaning: Swings are large against BTC's history: wider stops and smaller size are the usual response.

liquidations.label: Liquidations (24 h)
liquidations.reading: Long and short liquidations over 24 hours on Binance, Bybit and OKX perps (lower bound), as % of open interest.
liquidations.note: Context only: no state, no colour, no history (recorded from Nov 2026).

score.name: Financial condition score
score.requestedBy: Djahwell 2026-11-06: 'I'd still like a score and a bull or bear signal for the financial reading at that moment.'
score.rule: One vote per group, each -1..+1, from the rows' stated conventions (supportive +1, headwind -1, neutral / not coloured 0). Value = valuation row. Trend = mean of long-term trend and medium-term structure (so trend counts once). Positioning = leverage. Flows = mean of US spot demand and stablecoin liquidity (holders not coloured). Sentiment = sentiment row. Score = sum of available group votes x 2, range -10..+10, rounded to 1 decimal.
score.quorum: at least 4 of 5 groups available, otherwise withheld
score.label: Financial condition, by convention: describes how supportive today's figures are, not where price goes next. Not a tested forecast.
